Quando pede um rascunho de reclamação no: When you request a complaint draft on the website or through the MCP, we process the data you provide: the organisation concerned, a description of the facts, your requested resolution and, if supplied, your name, email, reference and date. To prepare an A Minha Rua report, we process the district, municipality, parish, address, category, subject and description. For e-balcão, we process the subject and message you write. To compare SIGA queues, we process the district, organisation, queue ticket type, radius and coordinates you provide or authorise. We use them only to generate the requested response. We do not create an account or store this content in a database. Your browser keeps the form while the page is open; downloaded files remain on your device.
Tratamos os dados técnicos necessários à: We process technical data needed to connect to and secure the service, such as IP address, date, URL and response code. Processing your request is based on providing the requested service; security and technical diagnostics rely on our legitimate interest in keeping the service available and protected. We do not use complaint data for advertising, profiling or automated decisions.
A Cloudflare fornece DNS, proteção e ent: Cloudflare provides DNS, protection and traffic delivery. The hosting provider processes requests to run the application. These providers may process technical data to deliver and protect the service, including on infrastructure outside the European Economic Area, subject to applicable contractual safeguards. We do not send drafts to Livro de Reclamações Eletrónico, ARTE or local councils.
Ao consultar ocorrências recentes, o nos: When you browse recent reports, our server reads up to ten public entries from the A Minha Rua portal and caches the response in memory for two minutes to limit requests to the portal. This lookup does not send your form fields to ARTE. Public entries may contain addresses and text written by third parties; always confirm details on the official portal.
Na comparação SIGA, o nosso servidor con: For SIGA comparisons, our server looks up public queues by district, organisation and queue ticket type. It calculates distance using coordinates in memory; it does not send them to SIGA. e-balcão receives the text only when you copy and submit it on the official portal.
O conteúdo submetido é processado em mem: Submitted content is processed in memory and discarded after the response. Access logs kept by the service do not contain request bodies and are deleted within a maximum of 7 days. If you email us, we keep the message for as long as needed to reply and meet any legal obligations.
Se usar o eCidadão através do ChatGPT, a: If you use eCidadão through ChatGPT, OpenAI also processes the conversation under your account terms and settings. The photo card may request camera access and, only if you tap “Use location”, your device location. When you continue, the photo and selected location are shared with your ChatGPT conversation to prepare a preview; our server receives only the factual description selected by the model and, when available, an approximate city or region. We do not store the photo or coordinates on the server or send them to public services at this stage.
